instruction: Go to the travel information section on the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: This variation asks the agent to navigate to the travel information/options page on United Airlines website. Similar to the original task (baggage fee calculator), this is a simple navigation task on the same website. The evaluator checks if the active tab URL matches the pattern 'united.com/en/us/fly/travel-options'. No custom functions needed as we reuse the existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks if active tab URL matches the travel options page pattern
Complete coverage: instruction asks to navigate to 'travel information page' and evaluator verifies URL contains 'united.com/en/us/fly/travel-options'
Data flow is correct: getter extracts active tab URL, metric performs regex pattern matching, expected value is semantically correct
Getter (get_active_tab_info) reads active tab URL from accessibility tree and retrieves full page info - appropriate for this navigation task
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) uses regex search to match URL pattern - correct comparison logic for URL verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor concern: get_active_tab_info() reopens the URL in a new page which could be fragile if there are session-based redirects, but should work fine for simple public website navigation
